policy: Frozen domain hypotheses, not clinician-elicited or causally established. Symbols refer to named author CSV columns; no guessed mappings for anonymous x columns. Thresholds are fitting-set medians in the standardized coordinate with positive feature scale.

metabric.status: anonymous feature mapping unverified; structural TEXGI prior only

gbsg.status: anonymous feature mapping unverified; structural TEXGI prior only; not GBSG2

support.status: anonymous feature mapping unverified; structural TEXGI prior only

flchain.basis: Official documentation reports elevated FLC associated with higher mortality; soft directional hypothesis on the ordinal FLC group, not a treatment or causal rule.

nwtco.basis: Documented disease-stage covariate; increasing-stage/increasing-relapse-risk is a prespecified domain hypothesis, not an effect estimate supplied by this documentation.

telco_clt.basis: Two-year contract is a documented commitment feature; protective churn direction is a prespecified business hypothesis, not independently verified causality.

telco_clv.basis: Same customers with monetary accumulation target; protective direction in this axis is an explicit exploratory transfer assumption, not calendar-time evidence.

employee.basis: Documented satisfaction feature; lower turnover hazard with higher satisfaction is a frozen soft domain hypothesis, not an expert elicitation or verified causal effect.

tcga.status: No invented expression-risk signs. Gene-importance membership comes from external IntOGen TCGA driver evidence; see public manifest.

custom.status: No named domain directions; structural TEXGI constraints only.
